chars.H: HAMZA: a young Moroccan man wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie with a black stripe across the chest, dark blue slim jeans, white sneakers.
chars.K: KHADIJA: a young Moroccan woman wearing a deep red headscarf (hijab), a long beige trench coat over a black outfit.
chars.A: AMAL: a young Moroccan woman with no headscarf wearing a bright turquoise oversized sweater with a big white star on it, light grey pyjama trousers.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: In a cozy Rabat apartment living room, HAMZA sits on a sofa secretly texting on his phone with a cheeky grin, hiding the screen with his hand, while KHADIJA sits right next to him with arms crossed, pouting and giving him a suspicious side-eye. Comic, awkward tension.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: HAMZA stands in the middle of a modern open-plan office, shrugging with both mitten hands up and an awkward guilty smile; behind him at a desk KHADIJA glares at him over her computer screen.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: KHADIJA sits on a bed in her bedroom ignoring a ringing phone lying beside her, rolling her eyes with her face turned away and arms crossed, sulking dramatically.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: In a Moroccan cafe-restaurant, KHADIJA sits at a table crying dramatically with big cartoon tears, while HAMZA stands next to her carrying a big pile of desserts, pastries and takeaway bags, looking exhausted.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: At night in a small bedroom lit by a bedside lamp, AMAL lies on her stomach on her bed texting on her phone, smiling and kicking her feet happily. A dark window with city lights behind.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: At night in his dark bedroom, HAMZA sits up in bed typing on his phone with both hands, nervous but determined, a little sweat drop on his head, phone light on his face.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: At night HAMZA sits on the edge of his bed staring at his phone in panic, biting his mitten hand, sweating, a wall clock behind him, tense waiting.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Split scene at night: on the left side AMAL in her bedroom holds her phone with a sly mischievous look; on the right side KHADIJA in her bedroom stares at her glowing phone with a shocked open mouth.
